prompts.canvas_blue_ivory.png: Create ONE production albedo texture for the blue-and-ivory continuous canvas roof of a small Japanese summer-festival serving stall, for the anime game Harumachi. Asset type: square seamless flat texture, preferably 2048 x 2048 pixels. The entire image is ONLY the textile surface seen perfectly orthographically from directly above, with no scene, no object silhouette, no margin, no perspective. EXACTLY ten equal-width vertical stripes across the square, alternating muted sky blue and warm ivory, stripes completely continuous from top to bottom. Broad clean flat anime colour fields, very subtle fine cotton weave and a few low-contrast thread variations. A little maintained sun fading, no heavy stains. Clean Japanese TV anime background / hand-painted cel style, restrained detail that will not shimmer at gameplay distance. Uniform neutral albedo illumination: no cast shadows, no directional highlight, no folds painted as shadows, no ambient occlusion. Geometry will supply folds and stitched edges separately. No seams or gaps between stripes, no rounded individual boards, no wood or plastic. No words, logos, text, rulers, numbers, border, watermark. It should tile in both directions as a striped cloth colour map.
prompts.cedar_weathered.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE seamless square albedo texture of well-maintained aged Japanese cedar timber for an anime summer-town game, preferably 2048 by 2048 pixels. The entire square is a perfectly orthographic flat wood surface, no object, no frame or border. Wood fibres run straight VERTICALLY from bottom to top (the texture V axis), predominantly long restrained parallel growth lines. Warm light honey cedar, a little silvered wear in places, small soft knots, subtle darker grain, restrained old finish and faint hand-worn variation. Bright clean Japanese TV anime background art: painted flat colour areas with a few precise drawn grain lines, not a photograph, not heavy painterly noise or photorealistic PBR. Neutral even colour-map lighting with no highlights, shadows, ambient occlusion, perspective or edge bevel. This is one continuous wood surface, NOT a row of separate planks: no board gaps, nails, hardware, big cracks, moss, letters or logos. Fine enough for long stall posts and noticeboard wood while still quiet at game distance. Seamlessly repeating in both directions. No watermark.
prompts.enamel_metal.png: Create ONE production seamless square albedo texture for the maintained ivory-grey enamelled metal casing of a small Japanese bakery deck oven in a clean anime game, preferably 2048 by 2048. Perfectly flat orthographic surface filling the entire square, no appliance or objects. Very pale warm silver-grey / off-white enamel with sparse gentle fine horizontal wiping marks, a little warm grey use variation and extremely restrained faint heat-yellowing speckles. It is cared-for equipment, not rusty scrap: almost all of the field stays clean and bright, calm low-contrast texture. Japanese TV anime background / cel painted surface style, precise restrained marks, no photographic PBR and no busy gritty noise. Neutral even albedo light, absolutely no specular glare, baked shading, ambient occlusion, vignette, large stains, edge wear frame or directional shadow. NO handles, seams, panel outlines, glass, knobs, screws, dials, labels, digits, text, logos, border or watermark; all those will be separately modeled real geometry. Tile seamlessly on X and Y.
